verdict.rationale: New Relic ships an official CLI (newrelic-cli on GitHub) for managing entity tags, workloads and deployment markers, plus entity search. It supports profiles for credentials and machine-readable output (JSON/YAML), and is documented for CI/CD pipeline integration, which suits scripted and agent-driven workflows. Additional official CLIs (nr1, nrdiag) round this out. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI being used in AI-native/agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can use the New Relic CLI to manage entity tags, define workloads, record deployment markers, and much more.
The New Relic CLI enables the integration of New Relic into your existing workflows. Be it fetching data from your laptop while troubleshooting an issue, or adding New Relic into your CI/CD pipeline.
--format string    output text format [JSON, Text, YAML] (default "JSON")
Profiles contain credentials and settings that you can apply to any CLI command
Entity Search: Search for entities across all your New Relic accounts
